prompts.name: milo-wave
prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: one isolated full-body Milo character for a professional CareerMate website. Input image is the identity and rendering-style reference. Preserve the same adorable apricot and cream fox, exact face, large brown eyes and ears, friendly proportions, fine soft 3D fur, sage cardigan, ivory T-shirt, charcoal shorts and brown shoes. High-resolution crisp detail, ideally 2048 square. Center the whole character with 8% safe space, ears, hands, feet and tail fully inside the image. Plain pure WHITE #FFFFFF studio background as an intermediate for later alpha extraction. Absolutely no checkerboard, no outline or sticker stroke, no glow, no floor, no cast shadow, no text, no watermark, no UI panels. Change the pose only: Milo smiles warmly and waves hello with his right paw held comfortably beside his face, his other paw relaxed, no tablet. Modest welcoming energy, feet grounded, camera front three-quarter at character eye height.
